title: 2 John 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: The apostle salutes the elect lady and her children.
Express his joy in their faith and love.

outline.text: The apostle salutes the elect lady and her children.
Express his joy in their faith and love.

context: This epistle is like an abridgement of the first; it touches, in few words, on the same points.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.
